findings.F1_all_gates_pass: Primary gate case ratio0.05_h0.0150_d96: a_err=-0.53%, delta_err=-1.01%, both well within 3% tolerance. PASS.
findings.F2_truncation_quantified: Domain truncation is the dominant modelling error: H/a=24→-2.90%, H/a=48→-1.64%, H/a=96→-1.01%. Convergence is monotonic and well-characterized.
findings.F3_alm_parameter_independent: ALM rho sweep (0.3, 1, 3) shows contact radius spread 0.019%, indentation spread 0.0003% — confirms penalty-free constraint enforcement.
findings.F4_peak_pressure_accurate: Consistent formulation peak pressure error +0.49%; lumped formulation +31.6% (expected: lumped pressure averaging overestimates peak).
findings.F5_tests_comprehensive: 8 tests cover: reference self-consistency, input validation, ring area conservation, stiffness assembly match, 3% gate, non-invasiveness, ALM independence, load monotonicity.
